description:
At Gilly Loco, we are passionate about crafting the finest chips and salsa that will tantalize your taste buds and leave you craving more. Our journey began with a simple mission: to embrace health and good food to create the best snacks in all of New Mexico and beyond.

As a family and woman-owned business, we take pride in every batch we make, ensuring that only the freshest and highest quality ingredients go into our products. Each chip is perfectly seasoned and cooked to crispy perfection, while our salsa is a symphony of flavors that will transport you to the heart of the Southwest.

Whether you're looking for a satisfying snack to enjoy on the go or a crowd-pleasing addition to your next gathering, Gilly Loco has you covered. Join us on this flavorful adventure and experience the taste sensation that is Gilly Loco Chips and Salsa

Products: 

Chips :

  • Fresh, Crispy Flavor – Gilly Loco chips are lightly salted with natural sea salt, giving them a deliciously bold flavor with just the right crunch.
  • Restaurant Style – Thick enough for dips, salsa, and cheeses, our tortilla chips are perfect for deep dipping and topping with your favorite condiments.
  • 100% Natural Ingredients – These corn tortilla chips are not only filled with amazing flavor, they’re made with all-natural, non-GMO ingredients.
  • Coconut Oil – Each delectable chip is cooked in organic coconut oil that offers healthier triglycerides and lauric acid for a better, healthy choice.
  • Satisfaction Guaranteed – We want you to love Gilly Loco products, which is why every order is backed by purity, natural ingredients, and true quality assurance.

Salsa:

Delicious Authentic Taste – Crafted with a premium blend of fresh tomatoes, peppers and onions, this traditional flavor is great for all your favorite recipes.

  • Fresh, Healthy Ingredients – Gilly Loco salsa is crafted from locally-grown vegetables free of preservatives and chemicals making them good for you.
  • Bold Flavor Choices – This traditional-style restaurant salsa comes in two unique flavors—toasty or sizzling—to provide the right amount of mouthwatering burn.
  • Add the Perfect Touch – Hot and mild traditional salsas are made specifically for your favorite Mexican meals, including chips, tacos, tamales and burritos.
  • American Made – Gilly Loco salsa is crafted right here in the USA, where we source the freshest ingredients and carefully blend our salsa for a healthy taste. Product Description:


Unique Selling Point:

USP for Gilly Loco Chips:
Experience Guilt-Free Crunchiness - Gilly Loco chips deliver a fresh, crispy flavor with just the right crunch, made from 100% natural, non-GMO ingredients. Cooked in organic coconut oil for healthier triglycerides and lauric acid, these chips offer a guilt-free snacking option. Perfect for deep dipping and topping with your favorite condiments, each bite is a wholesome indulgence backed by our commitment to purity, natural ingredients, and quality assurance.

USP for Gilly Loco Salsa:
Embrace Wholesome Flavor - Gilly Loco salsa offers a delicious, authentic taste crafted from premium, locally-grown ingredients free of preservatives and chemicals, making it a healthy choice for your meals. With two bold flavor choices — toasty or sizzling — our traditional-style salsa adds the perfect touch to your favorite dishes. Made in the USA, our salsa blends the freshest ingredients for a wholesome and flavorful experience that complements your healthy lifestyle.
